title: Understanding Residuals
text: Residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values from your model. If all residuals are negative, what does that tell you about the relationship between your predictions and the actual data?

title: Role of the Intercept
text: The intercept term in a regression model accounts for the baseline level of the dependent variable when all predictors are zero. What might happen to your predictions if this term is missing?

hintAnswer: The model does not have an intercept term.
title: Checking Model Components
text: Which of the following is a common issue when all residuals are negative?
choices: One or more of the features is a linear combination of other features.
$\hat{Y}$ is not a linear combination of the columns of $X$.
The prediction vector $\hat{Y}$ is not in the span of the design matrix.
The model does not have an intercept term.
